zambia.title: Flag of the Republic of Zambia

colors.note: Represents the country's lush vegetation and natural resources.
Symbolises the struggle for freedom from colonial rule.
Represents the nation's mineral wealth, especially copper.

desc:
- A green field with three vertical stripes of red, black, and orange in the lower fly
- An orange African fish eagle in flight soars above the stripes in the upper fly
- Adopted on 24 October 1964 at independence from the United Kingdom; minor hue revision in 1996
trivia:
- Zambia is unusual in placing its emblem and stripes in the fly rather than the hoist
- The African fish eagle also features on the national coat of arms
- Copper is the nation's key export, represented by the orange stripe and eagle
- A 1996 tweak adjusted the shade of green from a lighter to a darker hue
